description: Überschwemmungsgebiete (Landkreis Göttingen) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.landkreisgoettingen.de. Legal basis: Section 76 of the Water Resources Act (WHG). The lower water authorities have been responsible since 2005. Floodplains are the areas that are flooded statistically every 100 years (HQ 100). Flood zones have been identified for waters likely to pose a hazard. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Category: Floodplains in Göttingen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, inspireidentifiziert. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
